RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday,  the March 14, 2008/Phalguna 24, 1929 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Consumer Affairs,
Food and Public Distribution; Health and Family Welfare;
Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises; Railways; Steel )
Total number of questions — 20
68
Import of urea
*221. SHRI TAPAN KUMAR SEN:
SHRI PRASANTA
CHA TTERJEE:
Will the Minister of CHEMICALS
AND FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) the quantity of urea imported during
2004-05, 2005-06 and 2006-07;
(b) the estimated import during
2007-08;
(c) the cost of imported urea per tonne
during the above years;
(d) the present cost of the imported
urea; and
(e) the steps taken to reduce its import?
Coordination between States and
Central Government on agriculture
†*222. SHRI RUDRA NARAYAN
PANY: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) how his Ministry co-ordinates with
the Departments of Agriculture of the
States;
(b)  whether recently any conference of
the Ministers of Agriculture of the States
was convened in Delhi;
(c) the amount that would have been
incurred on the genuine welfare of farmers
in the country, so far;
(d) whether any conflict has arisen
between the Central Government and the
State Governments on the agriculture
budget so far; and
(e) whether Government is
contemplating to prepare ‘Agriculture
Budget’ on the lines of ‘Railway Budget’?
Review of policy of permitting big
retail corporates
*223. SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has lately
reviewed its policy on permitting big retail
corporates to expand their footprints in
retail markets, so as not to hurt local
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

69
groceries, including vendors of vegetables
and fruits;
(b) if so, the decisions taken in the matter
to protect the interests of small retailers
and consumers; and
(c) the steps taken and the directions
issued by Government in this regard?
Posts abolished in Railways
*224. SHRI TARINI KANTA ROY:
Will the Minister of RAILWA YS be pleased
to state:
(a) the number of regular employees vis-
a-vis contractors' workers in Railways
during the period 2001-02 to 2005-06,
category-wise and year-wise; and
(b) the number of posts abolished in
Railways during the corresponding period?
Rail accidents in the country
*225. DR. V . MAITREYAN: Will the
Minister of RAILW AYS be pleased to
state:
(a) the total number of rail accidents
reported across the country during the last
year;
(b) the total loss of life and property
due to these accidents;
(c) the compensation paid to the
affected families of the deceased in these
accidents;
(d) whether it is a fact that many cases
of compensation are still pending in the
Ministry and if so, how they are likely to
be disposed of;
(e) what are the reasons for these
tragedies reported;
(f) how many persons in the Ministry
found negligent in duties have been brought
to book; and
(g) what steps are being taken to prevent
such accidents in future?
Rise in the sale prices of steel
†*226. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of STEEL be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the consumer
sale price of steel has been on continuous
rise in the country during the past years;
(b) if so, the average prices of different
varieties of steel in the country during April,
2004 and at the end of December, 2007;
and
(c) to what extent the prices of all
material used in steel manufacturing have
increased during the said period?
Demand and supply of steel
commodity
*227. SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of STEEL be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware of the
fact that the demand for the steel
commodity is growing whereas the supply
is less;
(b) whether Government has taken any
steps to bridge the gap between demand
and supply of this commodity;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

70
Sale of gender identification kits
*228. SHRIMATI JAYA
BACHCHAN:
SHRI KAMAL AKHTAR:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that gender
identification kits are available for sale by a
US based company through a website; and
(b) if so, the steps Government is
contemplating either to ban the website in
the country or regulate its sale in the
country?
Disabilities due to alcohol
consumption
*229. SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
consumption of alcohol is ruining the health
of millions of young people in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether alcoholism is creating host
of diseases and disabilities in people;
(d) whether Government proposes to
take some tough decisions to check
alcoholism in the country; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Tobacco consumption by young
women
*230. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether WHO in its first Report on
global tobacco use and control efforts, has
revealed that the use of tobacco by young
women in India is rapidly increasing;
(b) if so, the facts and the details thereof;
(c) whether the steps taken by
Government to control use of tobacco by
citizens have not been proved effective;
and
(d) if so, the reasons therefor and further
strategies adopted to check the use of
tobacco, which is affecting the lives of
citizens?
Herbal treatment
†*231. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that treatment
with herbs has been found effective in the
country;
(b) whether it is also a fact that treatment
through aforesaid system is cheaper as well
as easy;
(c) if so, the reaction of Government
thereto; and
(d) whether Government has formulated
any scheme to make this system of
medicine more effective and if so, the details
thereof?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

71
Decline in female foeticide
†*232. DR. PRABHA THAKUR: Will
the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the cases of female foeticide
have declined after the formulation of strict
rules and law and if so, the figures of last
three years in this regard, State-wise and
year-wise;
(b) which are the States where majority
of incidents of female foeticide are
happening and the reasons therefor; and
(c) the names of States where the
percentage of female is lower than that of
male due to female foeticide, State-wise?
Pending projects of North Eastern
Region
†*233. SHRI O.T. LEPCHA: Will the
Minister of RAILW AYS be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of those rail projects of
North-East States which were approved
during the Tenth Five Year Plan but have
not been completed till date;
(b) the projects out of these on which
sanctioned amount has been spent; and
(c) whether Government has included
these sanctioned and pending projects,
particularly of Sikkim State, in the Eleventh
Plan and if so, the details thereof?
Future trading
†*234. SHRI AMIR ALAM KHAN:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is
contemplating to ban the future trading of
food items;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government has received
memorandum, etc. in this regard; and
(d) if so, the reaction of Government
alongwith the details of the action taken in
this regard?
Drought situation in Bundelkhand
region
†*235. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether drought situation has
emerged due to absence of rainfall in several
districts of Bundelkhand region in Madhya
Pradesh;
(b) whether Government is introducing
a scheme of water supply there for the
purpose of drinking water and agricultural
work; and
(c) whether Government is considering
to provide any financial package to State
Government by taking emergency measures
keeping in view the migration of people?
Mumbai-Kanyakumari dedicated high
speed corridor
*236. SHRI K. CHANDRAN PILLAI:
Will the Minister of RAILWA YS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Railways propose to
construct high speed passenger corridors;
(b) if so, the details of the reigons that
would be covered by these corridors;
(c) the details of the stations proposed
to be connected in the southern region;
(d) whether there is a proposal for
Mumbai-Kanyakumari dedicated high
speed corridor;
(e) if so, the details thereof; and
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

72
(f) the time by which the work on these
projects is expected to begin?
Effective scheme to improve the
condition of farmers
†*237. SHRI BHAGWATI SINGH:
SHRI BRIJ BHUSHAN
TIWARI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that farmers are
not getting the benefits of facilities and
packages declared by Government due to
which they are compelled to commit suicide
owing to indebtedness;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the loans
from banks for development of agriculture
have decreased and maximum rural branches
have been closed by the banks;
(c) whether Government is formulating
any effective scheme to improve the
condition of farmers; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
GDP spending on medical services
†*238. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a decision to
spend 3 per cent of gross domestic
production (GDP) on medical services in
the country was taken;
(b) if so, when the decision was taken;
(c) what percentage of GDP has been
spent on medical services during 2007-08;
and
(d) until when the amount as per the
above decision is likely to be spent on
medical sector?
National agriculture biosecurity
system
*239. PROF. M.S. SW AMINATHAN:
MS. MABEL REBELLO:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) the proactive steps being taken to
build an effective national agricultural
biosecurity system, in the context of the
second outbreak of Avian Influenza (H5N1
strain) in the country;
(b) whether Government has examined
the detailed recommendations given by the
National Commission on Farmers (NCF)
in their 4th Report submitted in April,
2006, on building a national agricultural
biosecurity system; and
(c) if so, what action has been taken, so
far, to implement the NCF
recommendations designed to insulate our
country from the ravages of trans-boundary
pests and diseases?
Poor performance of NGOs in AIDS
control
*240. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether a number of Non-
Governmental Organisations (NGOs)
which have been active in HIV/AIDS
prevention programme have been sacked
by Government after their non-
performance or poor performance;
(b) if so, the details of such NGOs,
State-wise; and
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

73
(c) the details of NGOs which have
been active in the field of HIV/AIDS
prevention programme of the National
AIDS Control Organisation (NACO) since
N
EW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 8th March, 2008 Secretary-General.
Phalguna 18, 1929 (Saka)
its inception and have now been sacked on
the basis of their poor performance or non-
performance?

I N D E X
(Ministry-wise)
Agriculture : 222, 235, 237, 239,
Chemicals and Fertilizers : 221,
Consumer Affairs, Food and
Public Distribution : 223, 234,
Health and Family Welfare : 228, 229, 230, 231, 232, 238, 240,
Micro, Small and Medium
Enterprises :—
Railways : 224, 225, 233, 236,
Steel : 226, 227.
74
MGIPMRND—809RS—08.03.2008.
